backward.cost: sum of the forward/backward native kernel costs; O(nodes + retained intermediate gradients) storage. Synchronous, individual kernels are not preemptible.
backward.failure: AutodiffNode/Loss, NumericShape/Domain/NonFinite/Overflow; requires a one-element loss, no mutation of tape; fatal work/memory budgets apply. Gradients retains intermediate native arrays until dropped.

backwardAccumulated.failure: AutodiffState/Node; constants return None and must not receive allocated gradients.

backwardWork.cost: O(rank) validation and empty metadata allocation; consumes tape, no full metadata freeze.
backwardWork.failure: AutodiffNode/Loss; requires a one-element loss. Existing Node storage keys are preserved.

binary.failure: NumericDomain/Shape/NonFinite/Overflow, AutodiffNode/Size; add/sub/mul only, shapes must match, broadcasting is explicit.

create.cost: O(1); VM-owned tape, checkpoint/revert uses COW metadata and shared native pages.

finishBackward.failure: AutodiffState until traversal completes; consumes work and releases tape metadata, returns existing Gradients.

finishForward.cost: append's existing conservative full-storage identity admission; actual identity is cached when the async companion prepared output first. Bridge callers supply a fully computed validated output.
finishForward.failure: AutodiffSize, NumericType/Domain; consumes work and returns tape/node only after successful append, never accepts a caller-supplied node key.

forwardWork.cost: bounded metadata validation and shared input descriptors, no numeric payload scan; consumes tape.
forwardWork.failure: AutodiffName/Node/Size, NumericDomain; parameter/constant, binary:add/sub/mul, unary:relu/sigmoid/tanh/exp/log/square, matmul, reshape/transpose/broadcast/sum/mean.

gradient.failure: AutodiffNode; None means constant or unreachable from the selected loss, not an allocated zero array.

nextBackward.failure: AutodiffState before preparation or after completion; returns immutable views, no tensor computation.

parameter.cost: O(elements) finite validation, no copy of numeric pages; name bounded to 128 UTF-8 bytes, at most 100000 operations per tape.
parameter.failure: AutodiffName/Size, NumericNonFinite; fatal work/memory budgets apply. Tape changes only on success.

prepareBackward.cost: At most 64 metadata entries per call; scalar loss seed only after complete initialization.

storeBackward.failure: AutodiffState/Node, NumericShape; accepts a fully computed gradient for a needed parent.

unary.failure: NumericDomain/NonFinite/Overflow, AutodiffNode/Size; relu/sigmoid/tanh/exp/log/square, relu derivative at zero is zero.

value.failure: AutodiffNode for a foreign or replaced node; structurally identical graphs are interchangeable.

binary.cost: bounded zip and identity preparation; matching shapes, explicit broadcasting. Consumes tape and returns the same graph/storage identities as synchronous forward operations.
binary.failure: NumericDomain/Shape/NonFinite/Overflow, AutodiffNode/Size/Task; no partial output or tape on failure/cancel, fatal work/memory limits apply.

broadcast.cost: O(rank) shared view, reuses parent storage identity; conservative append admission remains.
broadcast.failure: NumericShape/Type, AutodiffNode/Size/Task; consumes tape, no partial result on cancellation.

constant.cost: bounded finite validation and storage identity preparation; shares input pages, consumes tape.
constant.failure: NumericNonFinite, AutodiffSize/Task; no partial tape on cancellation, fatal budgets apply.

matmul.cost: O(m*n*k) scalar work in bounded chunks, shared inputs and COW output, then bounded identity preparation.
matmul.failure: NumericShape/Type/NonFinite/Overflow, AutodiffNode/Size/Task; fatal budgets apply, no partial tape.

mean.cost: bounded logical chunks preserving synchronous accumulation and final division, scalar output identity preparation.
mean.failure: NumericEmpty/NonFinite/Overflow, AutodiffNode/Size/Task; no partial tape on failure/cancel.

parameter.cost: bounded finite validation and storage-identity preparation; owns tape, shares numeric pages and returns tape/node on success. Existing conservative append identity work admission remains.
parameter.failure: same name/finite/size contract as synchronous autodiff.parameter; typed child task errors preserve diagnostic/budget codes and failed diagnostic line, no partial tape/node on cancellation, fatal limits apply. Kept checkpoints retain their own tape versions.

reshape.cost: O(rank) shared view for contiguous input; otherwise bounded logical copy and new storage identity preparation.
reshape.failure: NumericShape/Type/Size, AutodiffNode/Size/Task; no partial tape on failure/cancel.

sum.cost: bounded logical chunks preserving synchronous Neumaier order, scalar output identity preparation.
sum.failure: NumericNonFinite/Overflow, AutodiffNode/Size/Task; no partial tape on failure/cancel.

transpose.cost: O(rank) shared rank-two view, reuses parent storage identity; conservative append admission remains.
transpose.failure: NumericShape/Type, AutodiffNode/Size/Task; consumes tape, no partial result on cancellation.

unary.cost: bounded chunks for relu/sigmoid/tanh/exp/log/square and output identity preparation; consumes tape.
unary.failure: NumericDomain/NonFinite/Overflow, AutodiffNode/Size/Task; no partial tape on failure/cancel.

duration.failure: DateTimeRange; normalizes signed nanoseconds with checked overflow.

parse.failure: DateTimeSyntax/Calendar/Range; explicit RFC3339 offset, up to nine fractional digits, no leap seconds.

resolve.failure: DateTimeCalendar/Zone/Ambiguous/Gap/Range; gaps always fail, overlaps require an explicit policy.

beginTransaction.cost: O(DB transaction setup); independent of VM commit labels.

boolean.cost: O(1); SQLite integer 0/1 is converted explicitly, other integers return DbType.

bytes.cost: O(1) shared bytes; requires a Bytes cell.

cell.cost: O(value bytes); bounds failure is DbColumnRange, SQL NULL is DbValue::Null.

cellByName.cost: O(column names + value bytes); use a cursor's immutable column metadata.

close.cost: O(DB cleanup); awaits rollback and connection close, preserving SQL failure codes.

closeCursor.cost: O(statement cleanup); explicit close leaves the parent connection reusable.

closeStatement.cost: O(1); invalidates the affine handle, cache capacity remains bounded.

column.cost: O(column names); rejects absent or duplicated names instead of guessing.

commitTransaction.cost: O(DB commit); missing acknowledgement leaves outcome Unknown.

credentials.cost: O(connection-string and certificate bytes); immutable alias outside VM checkpoints.
credentials.failure: DbError; remote connections require verified TLS; certificate is DER, empty Bytes uses OS roots.

execute.cost: O(SQL work + parameter bytes); binds values without SQL interpolation.
execute.failure: DbError; DB writes are external effects and are not undone by VM revert.

executeMany.cost: O(SQL work + parameter bytes); prepares once for at most 1024 bounded parameter rows.
executeMany.failure: DbError; does not create an implicit transaction, earlier rows may have been applied.

executeStatement.cost: O(SQL work + parameter bytes); statement belongs to its original connection.

floating.cost: O(1); requires a Float cell, does not silently coerce strings or integers.

integer.cost: O(1); requires an Int cell, NULL and other types return DbType.

next.cost: O(batch bytes + SQL work); at most 64 rows and 4 MiB per batch.
next.failure: DbError; maxBytes is 1048576..4194304, deadline also respects the original query deadline.

postgres.cost: O(DNS + one TLS connection); no reconnect, failover or write retry.
postgres.failure: DbError; uses a registered opaque alias, never stores a connection string in trace fingerprints.

prepare.cost: O(SQL preparation); reuses a bounded per-connection statement cache.

privateParameter.cost: O(value bytes); immutable opaque alias outside VM checkpoints.
privateParameter.failure: DbError; values are bound privately and never included in request fingerprints.

query.cost: O(SQL prepare); rows are read only by next.
query.failure: DbError; one active cursor per SQLite connection.

queryStatement.cost: O(SQL preparation); rows remain lazy until next.

rollbackTransaction.cost: O(DB rollback); no VM state is reverted.

sqlite.cost: O(connection setup); at most eight native connections.
sqlite.failure: DbError; path is relative to root, :memory: is an isolated in-memory database.

text.cost: O(UTF-8 bytes); requires a Text cell.

waitForCleanup.cost: O(closed resources); waits without blocking the VM on native cleanup.
waitForCleanup.failure: DbError; preserves rollback/close failures from scope-owned resources.

add.cost: Four COW point updates; bulk construction is preferred for large edge sets.

bfs.cost: O(vertices + edges) bounded native traversal, times page lookup; returns native IntArray, -1 for unreachable vertices.

create.cost: O(1) virtual-zero storage; pages are admitted as touched. Capacity is at most 1048576.

fromEdges.cost: O(edges log pages); native bulk adjacency builder, no per-edge VM callback or coordinate List.
fromEdges.failure: Capacity/Shape or NumericIndex; input arrays are rank-one, equal length and retained immutable views.

arrange.cost: O(ids); prevalidates geometry and IDs before mutating the view.

bounds.cost: O(1); client area geometry for composing bounded overlays.

continueInput.failure: After revert, skips only events already delivered in this execution, including during replay.

dispatch.cost: Pointer scans in reverse draw order, at most 2048 widgets; Tab traverses controls.

focus.failure: UnknownId/NotInteractive; retains the widget selection and scroll.

focused.cost: O(1); disabled or removed controls have no focus.

graphemeEditing.failure: Enables cluster editing; existing scalar positions round forward to a boundary. Default is false.

nextEvent.failure: GUI must be published first; input is journaled, blocking, and replayable.

overlay.cost: O(combined widget count); at most 2048 controls. Copies bounded VM metadata; captions remain shared.
overlay.failure: GuiInvalidSize/EditingModeMismatch/WidgetLimit/DuplicateId; input views remain unchanged. Layer controls draw above base controls and take focus when the layer has focus.

present.failure: Queues a scene; publish may fail with GuiUnavailable or PublishPartiallyApplied.

remove.cost: O(widgets); rebuilds indices and preserves remaining selection, scroll and focus.
remove.failure: UnknownId; unknown input leaves the view unchanged.

scene.cost: O(widget count + caption bytes); serialized scene at most 1 MiB.

setChecked.failure: UnknownId/NotCheckbox; updates only the logical view.

setScrollPosition.failure: UnknownId/NotTextArea/InvalidScroll; prevalidates without changing focus or text.

style.failure: UnknownId/InvalidColor; retains every other widget property.

textBox.failure: Single-line editing with Unicode-scalar selection; 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

openFile.cost: Nonblocking Task over a bounded native request and response. Revert reuses the recorded operation; replay opens no OS dialog. Returned paths grant no file capability and the API never reads file content.
openFile.failure: Requires explicit external region and gui/external/tasks permissions; application task only. One native dialog per process. GuiDialogBusy/Unavailable/Thread/Title/Path/PathLimit/PathEncoding are typed. Cancellation by the user returns None; task cancellation closes the native request. Linux uses system GTK 3; Windows uses Win32 common dialogs.

saveFile.cost: At most 256 UTF-8 title bytes and 4096 path bytes; native UI state and physical worker lifetime are not checkpointed. external live retains only the task/checkpoint-owned result, without complete record/replay support.
saveFile.failure: Same boundary and lifetime as openFile. Selecting a destination does not create or truncate it. Native overwrite confirmation asks about the selected name; applications still perform and publish their own file operation.

close.failure: Unknown IDs return GuiWindowNotPublished; publish closes only the named surface.

continueInput.failure: After revert skips only named-window events already delivered in this execution; old gui input has a separate cursor.

nextEvent.failure: Blocks without scheduling VM tasks; wrong scoped fixture ID returns GuiWindowEventTapeEnd.

nextEventAny.failure: Blocks on native input across active windows; performs no VM task scheduling during the wait. Use pollAny with external-task completion polling; explicit VM task handoff is planned separately.

nextEventAnyAsync.cost: Cold task; nonblocking main-thread polling permits other VM and host tasks to advance. Empty waits use compressed observations.
nextEventAnyAsync.failure: One active any-window wait; competing pending waits return GuiWaitBusy. GuiClosed/GuiWindowNotPublished/GuiWindowEventTapeEnd are typed; cancellation consumes no subsequent event. Factory is called from the application task; staging remains main-task-only.

nextEventAnyLiveAsync.cost: Nonblocking main-thread polling; retains only results owned by tasks/checkpoints, no input observation tape.
nextEventAnyLiveAsync.failure: Requires external live region and gui/tasks/external/live permissions; one shared any-window wait. Restored task reuses its event; new factory consumes new input. Complete recording/replay unsupported; cancellation consumes no event.

poll.failure: Requires a published ID; None means no input; scoped fixture polling preserves another window event.

pollAny.cost: Bounded round-robin polling; does not block; combines native surfaces without merging their IDs.

present.failure: Stages a named surface; publish applies it. IDs are nonempty, <=128 UTF-8 bytes, NUL-free. At most 16 named windows / 16M client pixels including the legacy window.

close.cost: O(pending reads); physical connection never resurrects after revert.
close.failure: HttpError; cancels pending reads and releases the resource.

closeUpload.cost: O(pending operations); cancels the driver and queued writes.
closeUpload.failure: HttpError; scope exit closes the resource automatically.

component.cost: O(UTF-8 bytes); percent-encodes a query value or path component.
component.failure: Limit when the encoded component would exceed 1 MiB; does not encode an entire URL.

configured.cost: O(request bytes + response bytes); bounded 16 origin/CA client cache, native lease allowance and cold-client setup; same-origin connections are reused.
configured.failure: HttpError after awaiting; nonempty PEM certificates add trust, hostname/chain verification remains enabled. Client admission can return HttpMemoryLimit/NotSent before physical submission.

credential.cost: O(secret bytes); retains at most 64 immutable credential aliases.
credential.failure: HttpCredential/HttpCredentialImmutable/HttpCredentialLimit; accepts Secret<String>, never journals the private value.

download.cost: O(headers); body is consumed incrementally by read, total limit up to 1 GiB.
download.failure: HttpError; scope-owned connection, deadline includes all subsequent reads.

finish.cost: O(response bytes); ends the request body and awaits the bounded response.
finish.failure: HttpError; closing or cancellation does not undo bytes already sent.

get.cost: O(response bytes), with bounded origin/CA client caching and cold-client memory admission; returns a Task.
get.failure: HttpError after awaiting; no automatic redirect or retry.

read.cost: O(chunk bytes); retains a bounded transport buffer, chunks of 1..65536 bytes.
read.failure: HttpError; one outstanding read per connection, EOF returns None.

request.cost: O(request bytes + response bytes); at most eight native operations run concurrently.
request.failure: HttpError after awaiting; requires external region, deadline 1..120000 ms and body limit 1..4194304 bytes.

send.cost: O(request bytes + response bytes); public request uses a credential alias.
send.failure: HttpError after awaiting; fingerprint contains the public credential alias, never the private value.

upload.cost: O(headers); bounded producer queue, total upload up to 1 GiB.
upload.failure: HttpError; starts a request without holding the complete request body.

write.cost: O(chunk bytes); queues at most one chunk, each at most 65536 bytes.
write.failure: HttpError; acknowledgement means queued, remote application remains Unknown.

bearerCredential.cost: O(token bytes); at most 16 immutable aliases, 16KiB reserved per configuration.
bearerCredential.failure: HttpServerError; external boundary and Secret<String> required; 16..4096 ASCII graphic bytes, never included in operation records.

close.cost: O(active connections and requests); aborts all physical connections and releases pending requests.
close.failure: HttpServerError; neither explicit close nor scope exit can be undone by revert.

closeRequest.cost: O(1); releases a request without an application reply; an active peer receives 503.
closeRequest.failure: HttpServerError; a consumed/disconnected request cannot be replied to again.

configured.cost: O(maxBodyBytes * maxConnections); bounded request/response bodies, headers and queue.
configured.failure: HttpServerError; body 1..1048576 bytes, connections 1..8, whole connection lifetime 1..120000 ms, deadline 1..120000 ms.

configuredTls.cost: O(maxBodyBytes * maxConnections); adds 4MiB TLS memory reservation per connection.
configuredTls.failure: HttpServerError; registered alias required, TLS 1.2/1.3 HTTP/1.1; lifetime includes the handshake. Limits match configured.

configuredTlsAuthenticated.cost: O(configured connection capacity); includes TLS memory reservations; authentication is checked before VM input capture.
configuredTlsAuthenticated.failure: HttpServerError; requires TLS and bearer aliases. Missing/wrong/duplicate authorization receives 401 and closes; accepted authorization is removed from recorded requests.

listen.cost: O(configured connection capacity); reserves buffers before binding, at most four listeners.
listen.failure: HttpServerError; numeric bind address, port 0 chooses a free port. Plain HTTP/1.1; physical connections cannot be restored.

next.cost: O(request bytes); one outstanding wait per server. Request path/query retain URI encoding.
next.failure: HttpServerError; cancellation ends this wait, leaving the listener available; closing the listener cancels pending waits.

respond.cost: O(header bytes); body storage is shared with the transport; each request accepts one response.
respond.failure: HttpServerError; success means queued, not peer processing. No automatic retry; restored task receipts never resend. Framing headers are managed by Hyper.

tlsCredential.cost: O(PEM bytes); at most 16 immutable private configurations, 512KiB reserved per alias.
tlsCredential.failure: HttpServerError; external boundary required, PEM certificate/key each at most 64KiB. Only the alias enters operation records.

create.cost: O(parameters + elements) finite validation, shared native pages; <=128 names, each 1..128 UTF-8 bytes, encoded model <=32 MiB.
create.failure: NumericSize/Domain/Type/NonFinite; sorted names, no NUL; fatal work/memory budgets apply. No per-cell VM objects.

decode.failure: NumericSize/Domain/Shape/NonFinite; validates complete container, lengths, shapes, names, values and checksum before creating numeric pages. No code execution or external I/O.

encode.cost: O(elements + bytes) native serialization; dimensions and exact finite IEEE bits, canonical names, versioned format with SHA-256 integrity (not an authenticity signature).
encode.failure: NumericSize/Domain/NonFinite; fatal memory/work budgets apply. Serialization materializes a bounded Bytes value, not a streaming container.

load.failure: File:<code> or codec errors; observed file bytes follow existing journal/replay contract, work/history/file budgets apply.

save.failure: numeric codec errors; file writes and publish use existing fatal VM failures; deferred VM file write, physically visible only after publish, then not undone by revert.

weights.cost: O(parameters) metadata; COW numeric storage versions are shared.

dot.cost: Native chunks of at most 4096 products, preserving Neumaier ordering; yields between chunks. Inputs share native storage.
dot.failure: NumericShape/Type/NonFinite/Overflow; task cancellation and fatal budgets apply. No host worker is started.

eigenSymmetric.cost: Cyclic Jacobi bounded to maxSweeps; copy, symmetry check, scans, rotations, stable sorting and outputs execute at most 4096 scalar units per step with shared-page COW work, cached storage digests and bounded page-range rotation buffers.
eigenSymmetric.failure: NumericShape/Type/Domain/NonFinite/Overflow/Convergence/Size; finite symmetric square Float64 matrix, finite nonnegative tolerance and maxSweeps 0..10000. Same rotation/arithmetic order and stable eigenvalue order as numeric.eigenSymmetric, no partial result on error/cancel; fatal memory/work budgets apply.

leastSquares.cost: Full-column-rank QR O(m*n^2); bounded rhs validation, QR, compensated projection, upper substitution and permutation, with at most 4096 scalar units per step. Inputs and private numeric pages are shared; no full rhs/Q/R materialization or second factorization.
leastSquares.failure: NumericShape/Type/Domain/NonFinite/Overflow/Singular/Size; m>=n, rank-one rhs and finite nonnegative relative rank tolerance. Same arithmetic order as numeric.leastSquares. No partial output on error/cancel; fatal work/memory budgets apply.

matmul.cost: Native chunks of at most 4096 products and page-range COW writes; yields between chunks. Output initialization shares logarithmic zero storage.
matmul.failure: NumericShape/Type/Size/NonFinite/Overflow; task cancellation and fatal budgets apply. No partial output escapes a failed task.

norm2.cost: At most 4096 values per native step; scaled accumulation preserves logical order without materializing input or squaring large magnitudes.
norm2.failure: NumericType/NonFinite/Overflow; arbitrary ranks and views; same scaled result as numeric.norm2, task cancellation and fatal budgets apply.

qr.cost: Column-pivoted Householder O(m*n*min(m,n)); bounded native steps of at most 4096 scalar units, private shared-page COW work and task handoff between steps.
qr.failure: NumericShape/Type/Domain/NonFinite/Overflow/Size; economy Q and R, permutation as native IntArray; same arithmetic order as numeric.qr. No partial result on failure or cancellation, fatal work/memory budgets apply.

scale.cost: Shared logarithmic zero initialization; at most 4096 values per native step, bounded scratch and page-range COW writes.
scale.failure: NumericType/NonFinite/Overflow; arbitrary ranks and strided input; finite factor, no partial result on failure or cancellation.

solve.cost: Partial-pivot LU O(n^3) arithmetic with O(n^2) shared-page COW private storage; at most 4096 copies, pivot checks, swap pairs or update products per native step, including input initialization and back substitution.
solve.failure: NumericShape/Type/NonFinite/Singular/Size; square Float64 matrix, rank-one rhs, finite nonnegative relative pivot tolerance. Same arithmetic order as numeric.solve, no partial output on error/cancel. Fatal work/memory budgets apply; conservative per-step COW admission remains.

zipFloat.cost: At most 4096 element pairs per native step; shared inputs and logarithmic zero initialization, bounded scratch and page-range COW output.
zipFloat.failure: NumericShape/Type/Domain/NonFinite; add/sub/mul/div and matching shapes; division by zero fails. No partial result escapes.

prepare.cost: bounded postorder chunks of at most 4096 scalar/node units with O(log(storage pages)) traversal state and shared input pages; cache-independent handoff points.
prepare.failure: NumericType; owned opaque work survives checkpoints, cancellation releases the unretained work. No external observations or host worker.

mapFloat.failure: Same operations/domain/finite/rounding contract as numeric.mapFloat; no partial result on typed failure or cancellation. Fatal memory/work budgets apply.

adam.cost: O(elements) moment initialization; beta1/beta2 in [0,1), finite epsilon>0; moments use native pages and support checkpoint/revert.
adam.failure: OptimizerConfiguration or numeric validation failures; <=128 named finite Float64 parameters / <=32 MiB model.

adamStep.cost: O(parameters + elements), several bounded native buffers; synchronous, maximum 2^53-1 steps. Keeps two moment arrays per parameter.
adamStep.failure: OptimizerRate/Parameters/Iterations or NumericShape/Size/Domain/NonFinite/Overflow; typed failures leave state and input weights unchanged. Fatal VM failures require checkpoint recovery. Bias corrected Adam, epsilon outside sqrt.

sgd.cost: O(parameters + elements) work/storage; native buffers, exact name/shape match, positive finite rate.
sgd.failure: OptimizerRate/Parameters, NumericShape/Size/Domain/NonFinite/Overflow; fatal budgets apply. Inputs unchanged on error and success.

conjugateGradient.cost: O(iterations * (rows + cols + nnz) * log(max(rows,cols,nnz))); CSR validation/products and vector/norm/dot kernels yield after at most 4096 logical items; helpers share the current Task and native input pages.
conjugateGradient.failure: NumericShape/Domain/NonFinite; positive tolerance, 1..100000 iterations; NumericDomain also reports underflow of the squared search residual, square symmetric positive-definite input required. No dense materialization; zero initial guess, residual is ||b-Ax||, convergence target tolerance * max(1,||b||). Returns converged=false on iteration exhaustion; fatal budgets/cancellation apply.

matvec.cost: O(cols log(cols) + (rows + nnz) log(max(rows,cols,nnz))) work; bounded 4096 input checks, entries or row completions per step. Shared CSR/right pages, O(rows) COW output; no nnz-sized temporary copy or host worker.
matvec.failure: NumericShape/Type/Index/Size/NonFinite; canonical rank-one CSR and finite right values (including unused cells), compensated sums, same 2^20 size bound as sparse.matvec. Cancellation discards private partial output; retained task checkpoints preserve it.

yieldNow.failure: Only VM internal regions; forbidden in external regions and cleanup / guard execution. Does not wait for host input or allocate a new Task.

close.cost: O(pending operations); closes both halves and cancels pending operations.
close.failure: TcpError; scope exit also closes the socket. A restored VM handle does not recreate the connection.

configuredTls.cost: O(host bytes + PEM trust roots); a nonempty PEM bundle supplies explicit trust roots, up to 65536 bytes.
configuredTls.failure: TcpError; no hostname/certificate bypass. Empty PEM uses system roots. Client certificate authentication is not provided.

connect.cost: O(host bytes); at most eight sockets and eight pending operations.
connect.failure: TcpError; plain TCP, no automatic application retry, deadline 1..120000 ms.

connectTls.cost: O(host bytes + trust roots); verifies hostname and certificate with the system trust store.
connectTls.failure: TcpError; TLS 1.2/1.3, one deadline includes connect and handshake, no automatic application retry.

read.cost: O(chunk bytes); one outstanding read, 1..65536 bytes, EOF returns None.
read.failure: TcpError; timeout/cancellation closes the physical socket; a checkpoint retains completed receipts.

shutdownWrite.cost: O(1); sends EOF while keeping the read half available.
shutdownWrite.failure: TcpError; physical half-close cannot be undone by revert.

write.cost: O(body bytes); one outstanding write, at most 65536 bytes per operation.

clipGlobalNorm.cost: O(elements) scaled native norms, then O(elements) scaling only when clipping is needed; unchanged arrays share storage. Model parameter bounds apply. Synchronous.
clipGlobalNorm.failure: TrainingNorm or numeric/model validation errors; positive finite maximum, finite per-array norm required. Global combination avoids squaring large norms or materializing all gradient cells in a VM List. Inputs unchanged.

gradients.cost: One backward pass plus named metadata and model validation of selected cells; <=128 selected nodes, native pages shared. Returned map retains selected gradients only; intermediate gradients become collectible when the local owner is dropped.
gradients.failure: TrainingParameters/Unused, AutodiffNode/Loss or numeric errors; names follow the model contract, tape and selected nodes unchanged. Selecting constants or unreachable nodes is an error, not an invented zero gradient.

meanSquaredError.cost: O(elements) native forward kernels; same shape required, mean is over every element. Synchronous and subject to native work/memory budgets.
meanSquaredError.failure: AutodiffNode/Size or numeric validation errors; intermediate successful tape operations remain on a later failure.

mergeMean.cost: O(parameters + elements), native scale/add outputs; weights batch means by their positive sample counts. <=128 named parameters /32 MiB model; exact names and shapes required, inputs unchanged.
mergeMean.failure: TrainingSamples/Parameters, NumericShape/NonFinite/Overflow/Size; total count <=2^53-1 for exact conversion. Fatal budgets apply, no partial map escapes.
